navigator.title: IPEDS / College Navigator - West Virginia University (campus setting: City: Small; student-to-faculty 19:1)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2024) - the 2025-26 CDS is not posted yet. International applicants: 369 of 1,013 admitted (36%). Undergrad enrollment 18,206 is B1/B2 total undergraduates; intl_undergrads 314 is the B2 nonresident total. SAT composite 25/50/75 = 1010/1110/1210. GPA distribution is the 'all enrolled students' column (0.19% had GPA below 1.0). CDS C7 importance ratings and the C8A test-policy checkboxes could not be read from the PDF text, so factors are left out; the admissions site says tests are optional. No early decision/action reported here.

cost.notes: CDS G1/G5 (first-year, 2024-25). Nonresident tuition per credit hour $1,133, resident $362. Transportation estimate $1,290 not included in other_usd. CDS H6: 200 nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid, average $21,636; the PDF text does not show which aid-type boxes are checked.
